title: Oxva Xlim V3 Top Fill Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: The OXVA Xlim V3 Top Fill Cartridges are a welcome innovation for the hugely popular OXVA Xlim series, and are designed to deliver an exceptional vaping experience for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) styles. With an upgraded top-filling system, these cartridges allow for effortless refilling without the need to remove the pod from your device, making them more convenient and user-friendly than ever. Equipped with built-in mesh coils for optimal performance and flavour delivery, the Xlim V3 pods are available in four resistance options, giving you the flexibility to tailor your vape to your preferred style: Featuring an ergonomic mouthpiece and an anti-leak design, the Xlim V3 pods are engineered to minimise condensation and deliver a clean, hassle-free vape. The pods are pre-installed with their respective mesh coils, eliminating the need for manual coil changes. Each pod offers a 2ml e-liquid capacity and is fully TPD-compliant, making them ideal for use with nic salts and 50/50 e-liquids . The OXVA Xlim V3 Top Fill Cartridges are compatible with the OXVA Xlim Pod Vape Kits (except the Xlim C Pod Kit) and provide a perfect balance of convenience, flavour, and versatility for all-day vaping. Coil Details Please Note: The 0.4ohm Pod is ONLY Compatible with the following Kits. Oxva Xlim SQ Pro Oxva Xlim Pro Oxva Xlim Pro 2 0.4ohm (RDL): Designed for a richer, warmer vape, performing best at 26-30W. 0.6ohm (RDL): A perfect balance of flavour and vapour production at 20-25W. 0.8ohm (MTL): Offers a smooth, flavourful draw, perfect at 12-18W. 1.2ohm (MTL): Provides a cooler draw and more discreet vapour at 10-12W. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
